name: Feeds Instagram
description: A Feeds fetcher that imports Instagram Business Account media through the Facebook (Meta) Graph API using the facebook/graph-sdk library.
project_description:
Feeds Instagram provides a single Feeds fetcher plugin (id feeds_instagram_fetcher, title "Instagram") that pulls media from an Instagram Business Account through the Facebook (Meta) Graph API. It requires an Instagram Business Account connected to a Facebook Page you administer; complete steps 1-2 of the Instagram Graph API Getting Started guide to connect the account before importing.

The fetcher uses the facebook/graph-sdk PHP library (Facebook\Facebook). The Facebook App ID and App Secret are entered in the fetcher's plugin configuration on the feed type; the per-feed form runs a Facebook OAuth 2.0 login (permissions pages_read_engagement, pages_show_list, instagram_basic), exchanges the short-lived token for a long-lived one, and caches the access token in the dedicated cache.feeds_instagram_tokens bin. Selecting a Facebook Page resolves its connected Instagram Business Account ID, which is stored in the feed configuration.

Each import queries {ig_business_account_id}/media, walks the media edge (paging with next()) up to the configured import_limit, and requests per-item fields, returning a JSON array for the Feeds parser to map. Supported per-item data: id, instagram_id, shortcode, published_datetime, published_timestamp, type, media_url, thumbnail_url, caption, title, permalink, like_count, comments_count, owner_id, username, is_comment_enabled, children, comments. The recommended parser is the JsonPath parser from Feeds extensible parsers with context $.*. Depends on feeds and pcb (Permanent Cache Bust).
